goal: Post-Restart Resilient Deduplication & Native Drag-and-Drop Delta Classification (100 Files Interruption Scenario)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Deduplication Identity Triple: verify Name, File Location (relative path), and exact Byte Size + Format Category.
2. Durable confirmation write-through: persist remotely confirmed jobs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NSCloudDrive\cache\cloud-dedup-ledger.json.
3. Interruption & restart recovery: when PC is restarted after 85 of 100 files complete, durable ledger restores all 85 confirmations in <10ms.
4. Delta classification on re-drop: when user drags and drops all 100 files again, exactly 85 files are skipped (0 byte transfer) and only the 15 remaining files are queued.
5. Native UI Drag-and-Drop: enable AllowDrop = $true on WPF drive cards with accent border hover highlight and balloon toast feedback.
6. Staged VFS adoption resilience: verify Test-CloudDedupVerifiedFile before queueing staged files from mounted Explorer drives.
7. Sensitivity to changes: ensure format differences (PNG vs JPG) and byte-size modifications are detected and scheduled for transfer.
8. Author dedicated test suite tests/Test-PostRestartDropDeduplication.ps1 and register in tests/Run-AllTests.ps1.
9. Update docs/engineering/ARCHITECTURE.md with detailed post-restart deduplication architecture.
10. Recompile native NSCloudDrive.exe v2.0.0.0 and update SHA256 checksum.
11. Enforce strict 1:1 granular commit and push protocol for every file modification.

decisions.decision: Implement Record-CloudDedupVerifiedFile write-through in Process-CloudTransferQueue when jobs reach 'Completed and remotely confirmed'.
decisions.rationale: Prevents catastrophic amnesia upon unexpected machine shutdown or connection break; ensures confirmed cloud inventory survives machine restarts.

decisions.decision: Add Add-CloudTransferDroppedItems to CloudTransferManager.ps1 to stream-expand dropped directories and classify against durable ledger.
decisions.rationale: Allows both file and folder drop batches to instantly skip verified files and queue only delta files with zero UI thread freezing.

decisions.decision: Wire AllowDrop = $true and DragEnter/Over/Leave/Drop handlers on drive cards in src/NSCloudDrive.ps1.
decisions.rationale: Enables direct, intuitive drag-and-drop file ingestion into any cloud drive card with visual accent feedback and balloon notifications.

decisions.decision: Check Test-CloudDedupVerifiedFile in Import-StagedVfsFilesToTransferQueue prior to queue adoption.
decisions.rationale: Prevents redundant re-adoption of files copied directly into mounted Explorer drives that are already confirmed in the cloud.

reviewFindings.finding: Verified that Test-PostRestartDropDeduplication.ps1 asserts exact 85-file skip and 15-file queue behavior, strict mode is enforced, zero non-ASCII characters exist in NSCloudDrive.ps1, and native binary compiles cleanly.

securityFindings.finding: Verified cloud-dedup-ledger.json contains exclusively non-sensitive relative paths, hashes, and byte sizes with zero auth tokens or passwords.
